# Ray Huang

> Ray Huang (also Ray Chi Jui Huang, Ray CJ Huang) is a software engineer in San Francisco who built voice AI coworkers for car dealerships at Toma. Previously a product manager at Microsoft for nearly two years, working on Copilot automation and PowerPoint, and an intern at Amazon. UCLA Computer Science graduate.

Outside work: skiing, cycling, climbing, tennis, volleyball, coffee and squats.

## Experience

- Toma: Software Engineer, Jun 2025 to Oct 2026, San Francisco, CA. Built voice AI coworkers for car dealerships.
- Affil.ai (YC S24): Software Engineer (Contract), May 2025 to Jun 2025. Built the platform for affiliate networks.
- Microsoft: Product Manager, Aug 2023 to Apr 2025, Mountain View, CA. Built Copilot automation and reduced cost in PowerPoint.
- Vivid: Software Engineer Intern, Mar 2023 to Jun 2023, New York, NY.
- Microsoft: Product Manager Intern, Jun 2022 to Sep 2022, Redmond, WA. Grew Microsoft 365 user acquisition.
- Amazon: Software Development Engineer Intern (2021) and Future Engineer Intern (2020), Seattle, WA. Book ads team.

## Education

- University of California, Los Angeles: B.S. Computer Science. Regents Scholar, Amazon Future Engineer Scholar.
